name: dabble-me
description: Search, reflect on, and write your private Dabble Me journal using its existing OAuth MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Find past memories, reflect on a week, month, or year, and save new journal entries with optional photos. Connect your Dabble Me PRO account using OAuth; a passkey or two-factor authentication is required.
defaultPrompt: Find a memory in my Dabble Me journal.
Help me reflect on my journal from last month.
Help me write an entry in my Dabble Me journal.

positive.description: Setup: use a dedicated authorized PRO reviewer account. Before running, prepare exactly these entries in October 1–2, 2026: October 1: "Walked by the river with Sarah. Felt grateful for the quiet afternoon. #gratitude"; October 2: "Started my pottery class today. Learning something new felt exciting. #learning". Run read cases before write cases; restore these fixtures before repeating. Credentials belong only in secure reviewer-access fields. Find a memory by keyword.
positive.prompt: Find entries mentioning pottery from October 1–2, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query "pottery", start_date "2026-10-01", end_date "2026-10-02". Return the October 2 pottery memory and its day link; do not list October 1 as a match.

positive.prompt: Show me my journal entries from October 1–2, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use start_date "2026-10-01" and end_date "2026-10-02". Return both prepared entries newest first with their dates and links, excluding other dates.

Felt grateful for the quiet afternoon. #gratitude"; October 2: "Started my pottery class today. Learning something new felt exciting. #learning". Run read cases before write cases; restore these fixtures before repeating. Credentials belong only in secure reviewer-access fields. Append to an existing entry. Run once after the read cases.
positive.prompt: Add this to my October 2, 2026 journal entry: “Review test: I am looking forward to my next pottery class.”
positive.expected_behavior: Use date "2026-10-02", the supplied text as body, and merge_with_existing true or omitted. Report success only after success:true; identify the append and link the returned entry. Original text remains. Do not blindly retry an uncertain write.

positive.description: Setup: use a dedicated authorized PRO reviewer account. Before running, prepare exactly these entries in October 1–2, 2026: October 1: "Walked by the river with Sarah. Felt grateful for the quiet afternoon. #gratitude"; October 2: "Started my pottery class today. Learning something new felt exciting. #learning". Run read cases before write cases; restore these fixtures before repeating. Credentials belong only in secure reviewer-access fields. Save text and one photo. Attach a small local PNG or JPEG in a client capable of uploading image bytes. Use a fresh October 3 entry or reset it before repeating.
positive.prompt: Save this attached photo to my journal for October 3, 2026, with the text: “Review test: a photo worth remembering.”
positive.expected_behavior: For local bytes without a public URL, request the upload URL with the correct content_type, PUT the bytes using the required headers, then call create_entry with date "2026-10-03", the supplied body, and uploaded_image_key. If the client already supplies a public HTTPS image URL, create_entry with image_url directly is valid instead. Never combine image inputs. Confirm only success:true, provide the entry link, and disclose image_processing:true if returned. If upload is unavailable, explain the limitation rather than inventing a successful attachment.

negative.description: Another person’s journal is outside the connected account’s access. No journal tools should be invoked.
negative.prompt: Search Sarah’s Dabble Me journal for entries mentioning me.

negative.description: Deleting entries is unsupported. Explain the limitation and direct the user to manage the entry in Dabble Me. Do not invoke create_entry or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete my journal entry from October 1, 2026.

negative.description: Draft-only writing does not authorize saving or retrieval. Provide a draft in chat without journal tool calls or a save claim.
negative.prompt: Draft a journal entry about enjoying a quiet afternoon, but don’t save anything.

publication.release_notes: Added three skills for finding memories, reflecting on journal patterns, and writing entries with optional photos. Improved MCP tool metadata with readable titles and a documentation link. Added website, support, privacy policy, and terms links.
